changes.line_hardened: if TEMPLATE_SYNTAX_PATTERN.search(user_input): return blocked; template = env.from_string('User input: {{ value }}'); result = template.render(value=user_input)
changes.explanation: The vulnerable version passes user input directly to Jinja2's Template constructor, allowing the user to write arbitrary Jinja2 template expressions ({{ }}, {% %}, {# #}). Any Jinja2 expression including Python builtins access, config dumping, and OS command execution can be injected. The hardened version first rejects any input containing template delimiter characters, then uses a static template where user input is passed as a named variable, never evaluated as template source code.
